name: Pirelli & C. S.p.A.
summary: Pirelli & C. S.p.A., through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells tires for cars, motorcycles, and bicycles in Europe, North America, the Asia-Pacific, South America, Russia, India, the Middle East, and Africa.
